enchantments.tooltip: Psychic Ward: This items wards you against mind-altering effects and spells, such as Charm and Domination.
Good Luck +1: This item gives a +1 Luck bonus to all saves and skill checks.
Reflex Save +5: This item gives a +5 Resistance bonus to your Reflex saves.
Quality Alluring Skills Bonus: +2 Quality bonus to Bluff, Diplomacy, Haggle, Intimidate, and Perform.
